intro.text: Duke Kird's daughter, twenty-eight years old, whom Flint thinks would rule better than the present royal family.
Duke Kird's daughter, who becomes Minister of Espionage when her father takes the crown.

items.text: When the king sent Count Flint to spy on her father, Kird saw through him and asked him to train Melsi as a spy instead. She learned well and the two grew very close, until, without either meaning to, they became a couple, though Flint was thirty years older. He didn't love her, but a lifetime of carousing had taught him to string women along. Her father approved, hoping the match would tie Flint to him.
Seeing at last that she looked on him as a mentor, Flint left her, which broke her heart and enraged her father.
When her father took Kingseat and made himself king, he named Melsi his Minister of Espionage. In time she forgave Flint.
